---
title: "Reading Statistics"
---

An overview of my reading activity, including completed books,
daily reading habits, and longer-term trends.

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

# Load reusable functions
source("R/reading_helpers.R")

# Import datasets
books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

reading_log <- read_csv(
  "data/reading_log.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    book_id = col_character(),
    date = col_date(),
    page_reached = col_integer()
  )
)

# Calculate individual book progress
book_progress <- calculate_book_progress(
  books,
  reading_log
)

# Aggregate reading across books
daily_reading <- book_progress |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(
    pages_read = if (anyNA(pages_read)) {
      NA_integer_
    } else {
      sum(pages_read)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  complete(
    date = seq.Date(
      min(date),
      max(date),
      by = "day"
    ),
    fill = list(pages_read = 0L)
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

# Summary statistics
books_finished <- sum(
  books$status == "Finished",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

books_reading <- sum(
  books$status == "Reading",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Pages in completed books with known lengths
completed_pages <- books |>
  filter(
    status == "Finished",
    !is.na(total_pages)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    pages = sum(total_pages),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pull(pages)

# Pages recorded through daily logging
total_pages <- sum(
  daily_reading$pages_read,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

reading_days <- sum(
  daily_reading$pages_read > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

calendar_days <- nrow(daily_reading)

average_daily <- if (calendar_days > 0) {
  round(total_pages / calendar_days, 1)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

average_reading_day <- if (reading_days > 0) {
  round(total_pages / reading_days, 1)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

# Most recent 30 days of recorded history
recent_reading <- daily_reading |>
  filter(
    date >= max(date) - 29
  )

# Determine the months covered by our records
recorded_dates <- c(
  reading_log$date,
  books$date_finished
)

recorded_dates <- recorded_dates[
  !is.na(recorded_dates)
]

# Include all intervening months, up to 12
month_sequence <- seq.Date(
  from = lubridate::floor_date(
    min(recorded_dates), "month"
  ),
  to = lubridate::floor_date(
    max(recorded_dates), "month"
  ),
  by = "month"
) |>
  tail(12)

# Choose readable labels for monthly charts
month_breaks <- unique(c(
  month_sequence[
    seq(
      1,
      length(month_sequence),
      by = if (length(month_sequence) > 6) 2 else 1
    )
  ],
  tail(month_sequence, 1)
))

# Monthly pages read
monthly_reading <- tibble(
  month = month_sequence
) |>
  left_join(
    daily_reading |>
      mutate(
        month = lubridate::floor_date(date, "month")
      ) |>
      group_by(month) |>
      summarise(
        pages_read = sum(
          pages_read,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "month"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pages_read = replace_na(pages_read, 0L)
  )

# Books completed by month
completed_by_month <- tibble(
  month = month_sequence
) |>
  left_join(
    books |>
      filter(
        status == "Finished",
        !is.na(date_finished)
      ) |>
      mutate(
        month = lubridate::floor_date(
          date_finished, "month"
        )
      ) |>
      count(
        month,
        name = "books_finished"
      ),
    by = "month"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    books_finished = replace_na(
      books_finished,
      0L
    )
  )
```

## Reading Overview

- **Currently reading:** `{r} books_reading`
- **Books completed:** `{r} books_finished`
- **Pages in completed books:** `{r} completed_pages`
- **Pages logged by date:** `{r} total_pages`
- **Days with reading:** `{r} reading_days`
- **Average pages per calendar day:** `{r} average_daily`
- **Average pages per reading day:** `{r} average_reading_day`

Daily reading statistics cover the period from my first
recorded reading date through my latest logged date.
Pages in completed books are reported separately from
daily page logs to avoid double-counting.

## Recent Reading Activity

Pages read per day over the most recent 30 days of
recorded reading history.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

date_breaks <- if (nrow(recent_reading) <= 7) {
  recent_reading$date
} else {
  seq.Date(
    from = min(recent_reading$date),
    to = max(recent_reading$date),
    by = "1 week"
  )
}

ggplot(
  recent_reading,
  aes(x = date, y = pages_read)
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#4C7087",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = date_breaks,
    date_labels = "%b %d"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Pages Read"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Monthly Reading

Total pages read per month, covering the months for
which reading records are available, up to 12 months.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

ggplot(
  monthly_reading,
  aes(x = month, y = pages_read)
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#4C7087",
    width = 22
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = month_breaks,
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    expand = expansion(add = c(18, 18))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Pages Read"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

## Books Completed by Month

Number of books finished each month, covering the
months for which records are available, up to 12 months.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

ggplot(
  completed_by_month,
  aes(x = month, y = books_finished)
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#4C7087",
    width = 22
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = month_breaks,
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    expand = expansion(add = c(18, 18))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      max(1, completed_by_month$books_finished),
      by = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Books Completed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```
